test_title: PYST 32: SSC CHSL 2024 - English (Held On: 10 Jul, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
Select the word segment from the options that can substitute the bracketed word segment meaningfully.

Telangana artists (are know for the amazing bronze castings).

options.text: Is known to the amazing bronze castings
Have to know the amazing bronze castings
Have been knew to the amazing bronze castings
Are known for their amazing bronze castings

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase** “are know for”** is incorrect and should be replaced with** “are known for”.**
 
• Using** “their” **makes the sentence more specific to the artists of Telangana.
 
• The correct phrase should be “are known for their amazing bronze castings,” ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Telangana artists **are known for **their amazing bronze castings."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: “Is known to the amazing bronze castings”** – Incorrect due to subject-verb agreement and inappropriate preposition usage.
 
• **Option 2: “Have to know the amazing bronze castings”** – Incorrect as it changes the meaning entirely.
 
• **Option 3: “Have been knew to the amazing bronze castings”** – Incorrect due to improper verb form usage.
